posts.title: Strings in C
posts.description: Strings in C are peculiar. They are especially strange once you are familiar with strings in another higher-level programming language. I want to share an approach that makes my life easier whenever I write tiny C programs. Context How are strings represented in C? Technically, strings do not exist in C. posts.title: Review: 2026 Week #44 (Oct 26 - Nov 1)
posts.description: Autumn is here. My hands get quite cold even after a short bike ride to the gym. Time to bring out my Buffs and gloves to keep the cold away. I was able to work out every single day this week. So I am pretty happy about it. The body has adjusted well to the end of DST, and I woke up consistently around 6 AM. After work, I re-read The Old Man and The Sea by Hemingway for the third time.
